title: Settlement of an Approved Refund Claim on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
This bulletin of the refunds and settlement office states how a lodged claim on an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking is settled.

## 1. Timing

The settlement takes the brand's processing time, counted in business days from the day the claim was lodged, excluding weekends and public holidays in the traveller's country of residence.

## 2. The state condition

A payout line is raised only while the booking record stands at cancelled, refund pending or refunded. The record decides; a booking standing in any other state carries no payout line.

| Booking record stands at | A payout line may be raised |
| --- | --- |
| cancelled | yes |
| refund pending | yes |
| refunded | yes |
| any other state | no |

## 3. Ceilings on what is paid

A payout may never exceed the amount that original line actually collected, and the sum of a booking's payouts may never exceed the amount paid on the booking.

## 4. Where the airline does not pay

Where the airline declines the claim, the booking is closed with no payout and the traveller is told which airline reference declined it.

A claim that the airline has not answered within the brand's processing time is escalated rather than settled out of agency funds.

## 5. Clauses no longer in force

> "Each payout line is raised against the original fare line it reverses, so a booking with several fare lines settles as several payout lines and never as one lump sum."

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the return of carrier-imposed taxes on an unflown ticket on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

> "A lodged claim settles in the form the fare brand prescribes and in no other form: money to the card, or value on a voucher, never both and never a mixture."

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the return of carrier-imposed taxes on an unflown ticket on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

The clauses in sections 1 to 4 are unaffected by those retirements and stand as written. In particular the ceilings in section 3 and the state condition in section 2 continue to govern every payout line raised on a booking.

## 6. Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical claim is lodged on a Monday against a brand whose processing time is 5 business days, in a country whose Thursday of that week is a public holiday. Counting business days from the day of lodging and excluding weekends and that holiday, the settlement falls due on the Tuesday of the following week. Were the airline not to have answered by then, the claim is escalated rather than paid from agency funds.
